property_summary: For any uint input _val, calling SetMinSum(_val) on the correct contract always succeeds (does not revert) and sets C.MinSum to _val; the mutant negates and casts which underflows/reverts for many _val (non-zero) causing the call to revert/fail for those inputs.
change_summary: Negate the provided value before assignment (cast via unary minus on uint wraps underflow in Solidity 0.8 causing revert), altering whether assignment succeeds and thus observed MinSum.
